name: Ogrekin Human Fighter 3
body:
Ogrekin Human Fighter 3	CR 3

XP 800
Male ogrekin human fighter 3
CN Medium humanoid (giant)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, Perception -1

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 11, flat-footed 19
(+4 armor, +1 Dex, +5 natural)
hp 28 (3d10+12)
Fort +7, Ref +2, Will +0

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +9 (1d4+6)
Tactics He shrieks and yells as he fights, saying things like, “Me get big reward for your head, pretty elf!” or, “You go in pit now! Me feed you later. Maybe!” He fights barefisted, pummeling foes mercilessly.

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 13, Con 18, Int 6, Wis 8, Cha 8
Base Atk +3; CMB +9 (+11 grapple); CMD 20 (22 vs. grapple)
Feats Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike,
Weapon Focus (unarmed strike)B, Improved GrappleB
Skills Swim +12;
Languages Common
SQ armor training I, bravery +1, ogrekin deformities
Gear +1 studded leather armor

SPECIAL ABILITIES
Ogrekin Deformities (Ex)

This creature’s head is monstrously deformed and his skin is thick and blubbery. This increases his natural armor bonus to +5, but his unfortunate deformities reduce his Intelligence by a further 2 points.
